messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — we're adding a per-model "spot" quota slider in the console that lets teams allocate spare capacity for lower-cost routing. Need ideas for how the UI previews estimated token burn, cache savings, and regional split. Keep it compact.
Sam (eng): Love the slider. Question: should preview assume cache credits are applied before routing decisions? we might double-count savings if not careful.
Ben (backend): Good call. Backend will emit a preview API: `POST /internal/preview-quota` with payload {model, slider_pct, region_pref}. It returns `est_tokens`, `est_cache_hits`, `est_cost`. Example: `{"est_tokens":12000, "est_cache_hits":0.32, "est_cost":23.4}`. Link to proto: https://go/r/quota-preview-proto
Maria (design): For the console mock I sketched a tiny sparkline + 3-chip summary: estimated daily tokens, %cache saved, and hotspot region. Also a mini-heatmap for regions. Want to avoid huge tables.
Luca (data): Heads up — our telemetry sampling skews cache_hit_rate per-route (cold starts overrepresented). For previews we should use a 7d decayed average and a bias-correction factor. SQL we use: ```SELECT route, approx_percentile(hit_rate, 0.5) FROM cache_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY route;```
Sam (eng): Thanks Luca. So the preview API should accept `sampling_adjustment` param? We can default to server-side correction if provided.
Ben (backend): Yeah we'll add `sample_weight` optional. But another edge: embeddings cache entries are shared across tenants for some models => cost attribution fuzzy. Should the preview note "shared cache - savings uncertain"?
Priya (PM): Yes call that out. UX: flag when cache savings are likely unstable. Tooltip: "Shared cache across tenants may lower estimated savings; use dedicated cache if you need reliable credits."
Ava (product): Also want ability to toggle between "global estimate" and "per-region breakdown". Default to global but show a small chevron to expand. If region has < 5 p99 requests/day show a warning about noisy estimate.
Maria (design): I'll add the chevron and a dimmed noise-warning state. Visuals: heatmap cell shows sparkline on hover, click opens a mini-distribution.
Luca (data): One more: for canaries we should show two-preview lanes (current vs slider) so teams can see marginal delta. That avoids manual math.
Sam (eng): Implementation note: previews must run fast (<300ms). We'll compute estimates from pre-aggregated rollups and fallback to async job if data is missing.
Ben (backend): Ops-bot deployed a small infra change earlier; might affect rollup timelines. ops-bot can you confirm rollup lag?
ops-bot: Deploy: rollup-worker v2.3 -> staged in prod. Expected lag for new prefixes: ~12m. :rocket:
Priya (PM): OK keep the slip in mind for preview freshness. Action items: Ben implement `preview-quota` proto, Luca provide corrected hit-rate function, Maria iterate mock with chevron + noise state, Sam add sample_weight param + perf budget. We'll reconvene after mocks. :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): I'll add unit tests for double-count scenarios (shared cache + routing fallback).
Ben (backend): Putting PR up shortly. ETA EOD.
Maria (design): Mocking now, will drop Figma link in thread when ready.
Luca (data): Will push pre-agg query and provide numbers for sample_weight by EOD.
Ava (product): Thanks all — this will help teams understand the tradeoff between low-cost routing and uncertain cache credits.
Priya (PM): Closing loop: can we surface expected dollar delta per 10k tokens too? small text under chips: "~$0.20 saved per 10k tokens" — yes/no?
Sam (eng): Yes we can compute normalized unit numbers from est_cost. I'll add a `normalized_delta_per_10k` field in response.
Priya (PM): Perfect.
